evidence: The entire ppt-web community feature (posts, groups, events, marketplace, comments) is shipped English-only: only 1 of its 17 .tsx files (components/PostCard.tsx) imports useTranslation / react-i18next. ppt-web ships react-i18next with sk/cs/de/en locales, so every other string in this feature is an i18n gap, not a missing capability — sibling features (disputes pages, buildings, etc.) are t()-wrapped.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/community/components/EventForm.tsx:137,154,274 — hardcoded placeholders 'Enter event title', "What's this event about?", 'Leave empty for unlimited'; :291 button 'Cancel'; :297-304 button label 'Creating...' / 'Updating...' / 'Update Event' / 'Create Event' — all literal English, no useTranslation import in the file.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/community/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx:194,265,274 placeholders 'Search items...' / 'Min €' / 'Max €'; ItemForm.tsx:180,204,221 placeholders 'Enter image URL' / 'What are you selling?' / 'Describe your item in detail...'. EventsPage.tsx:153,254 'Create Event'. CreateGroupPage.tsx:45 heading 'Create New Group'.

Landable frontend-only remedy: add useTranslation to the community components/pages and move the literals behind t('community.*') keys (add the keys to each locale file). Verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/web typecheck` and Vitest/RTL render assertions that non-en locales render localized labels. Confidence medium (static): confirmed only PostCard.tsx uses i18n via grep across all 17 files; breadth (whole feature) makes this a systemic gap rather than one stray string.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/components/EvidenceUploader.tsx:71,74 — the validate() helper returns hardcoded English error strings `Unsupported file type: ${...}` and `File too large (max 50 MB): ${file.name}`. These are user-facing: they are stored on item.error and rendered to the user at :266-268 (`{item.error}`). The component already imports useTranslation and uses t() for every aria-label (:167,185,225,288,297), so the visible validation messages are an inconsistent i18n gap, not an untranslated-everywhere file.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/components/EvidenceUploader.tsx:213-218 — drop-zone visible text 'Drop files here or browse' and the hint 'JPG, PNG, PDF, MP3, MP4 · max 50 MB per file · up to {MAX_FILES} files' are hardcoded English; :274 input placeholder 'Short description (optional)'; :278,312 the `Description for ${name}` and `Remove ${name}` aria-labels are raw template strings (not t()), unlike the other aria-labels in the same file.
